summary.zh-CN: 从选题到发布包：选题研究、多渠道改写、品牌事实核对、发布包整理与复盘，产出都是待你审阅的草案。
summary.en: From topics to publish packs: topic research, multi-channel adaptation, brand fact checks, publish packs and reviews, all as drafts for your review.

now.zh-CN: 基于品牌材料输出选题方向与受众画像草案
now.en: Draft topic directions and audience profiles from your brand materials

now.zh-CN: 改写为公众号、小红书、微博、抖音脚本、LinkedIn、X 等版本
now.en: Adapt copy for WeChat, Xiaohongshu, Weibo, Douyin scripts, LinkedIn and X

now.zh-CN: 逐条核对产品数据、禁用表述与素材权利
now.en: Check product claims, banned phrases and asset rights line by line

now.zh-CN: 整理发布包；按你提供的数据写复盘，不编数字
now.en: Assemble publish packs; review results from data you provide, never invented numbers

needs.zh-CN: 品牌手册、产品事实库、禁用表述与素材权利清单
needs.en: Brand guide, product facts, banned phrases and asset rights list

needs.zh-CN: 目标渠道、账号与发布目标

permissions.zh-CN: 只读取你提供的材料，不登录任何平台账号
permissions.en: Reads only your materials and never signs in to platform accounts

permissions.zh-CN: 需你确认才会做：发布内容、投放广告、以账号身份互动
permissions.en: Only with your confirmation: publishing, buying ads or interacting as your account

conditions.zh-CN: 平台格式约束为常见做法，发布前以平台现行规则为准。
conditions.en: Channel formats follow common practice; check current platform rules before publishing.
